transcript.text: Before we finalize this proposal, I need to share some important findings. I recently completed a six-week pilot with our community partners, and I finished the pilot report just this week — though I haven't yet attached it to the approval proposal. The pilot revealed two key things: first, students need 60 placement hours to achieve the course outcomes we're aiming for, and second, a faculty-reviewed portfolio worked far better than a final reflective essay for assessing student learning. I'd recommend we update the proposal to reflect these findings before the catalog is submitted.
